units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:12">Sot. IX, 12</cite> (with the destruction of the Temple) <he>ניטל שׁוּמַן הפירות</he> the fruits lost their fatness.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:13">Ib. 13</cite> <he>המעשרות נטלו את ש׳ הדגן</he> when the tithes ceased, the corn lost its fatness.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 18a:9">Bekh. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ יהא ביניהן</he> the fatter of the two animals remains under litigation, v. <cite ref="U01496"><he>שָׁמַן</he></cite>.
Y. B. Kam. IX, beg. 6ᵈ מחזיר לו את הש׳ he must make restitution for the fat animal (as it was before it deteriorated); a. fr.—Esp. the permitted fat of animals, contrad. to חֵלֶב.
<cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 4:1">Ker. IV, 1</cite> <he>ש׳ וחלב לפניו</he> if a person had before him permitted fat and forbidden fat.
Lev. R. s. 22 את החלב התרתי לך את הש׳ (I forbade thee) ḥeleb, and (as an offset) I allowed thee shuman; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ חזיר</he> lard; <cite ref="Chullin 91a:1">Ḥull. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>שַׁמְנוֹ</he> (Ms. M. <he>שׁוּמְנוֹ</he>) the fat on the sinew of the hip; <cite ref="Chullin 92b">ib. 92ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>שומ׳</he>, a. once <he>שמ׳</he>); <cite ref="Pesachim 83b">Pes. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>שמ׳</he>.
